reason: FREEDOM (denosumab): 7868 women aged 60-90 with T score between -2.5 and -4.0. Served RR 0.32 (0.26-0.41) printed. The registry's Primary Efficacy Analysis Set requires baseline and >=1 post-baseline evaluation, with LOCF: NOT ITT (label imprecise).
reviewed_note: FREEDOM (denosumab): 7868 women aged 60-90 with T score between -2.5 and -4.0. Served RR 0.32 (0.26-0.41) printed. The registry's Primary Efficacy Analysis Set requires baseline and >=1 post-baseline evaluation, with LOCF: NOT ITT (label imprecise).

population.span: We enrolled 7868 women between the ages of 60 and 90 years who had a bone mineral density T score of less than -2.5 but not less than -4.0 at the lumbar spine or total hip.

endpoint.span: The primary end point was new vertebral fracture.

estimate.span: As compared with placebo, denosumab reduced the risk of new radiographic vertebral fracture, with a cumulative incidence of 2.3% in the denosumab group, versus 7.2% in the placebo group (risk ratio, 0.32; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.26 to 0.41; P<0.001)

ci.span: As compared with placebo, denosumab reduced the risk of new radiographic vertebral fracture, with a cumulative incidence of 2.3% in the denosumab group, versus 7.2% in the placebo group (risk ratio, 0.32; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.26 to 0.41; P<0.001)

analysis_set.span: Primary Efficacy Analysis Set, which includes all randomized participants who have a baseline and ≥ 1 postbaseline evaluation of vertebral fracture at or before 3 years. Last Observation Carried Forward was used.

treatment_strategy.span: Subjects were randomly assigned to receive either 60 mg of denosumab or placebo subcutaneously every 6 months for 36 months.

follow_up.span: Subjects were randomly assigned to receive either 60 mg of denosumab or placebo subcutaneously every 6 months for 36 months.

entry_population_reading.span: Denosumab for prevention of fractures in postmenopausal women with osteoporosis.

entry_population.extractor_why: The source identifies postmenopausal women with osteoporosis, matching the question; the restricted outcome analysis set is addressed separately.

extractor_mismatch_note: The served_row estimate, confidence interval and RR scale match the source. Its intention-to-treat label does not describe the registry's restricted Primary Efficacy Analysis Set, which requires baseline and postbaseline vertebral-fracture evaluations and uses Last Observation Carried Forward. The served_outcome.served_estimand label HR is also incorrect for this endpoint; the reported effect is RR.
